tools.name: download_vector
tools.description: No key needed for a token from a preview made without a key, once the person has claimed it (the first download costs 1 credit from their account); before that it answers status "waiting_for_claim" with the claim_url. Other tokens need an API key. Gets a file for an image token from an earlier conve

tools.name: list_conversions
tools.description: No key needed for tokens you already hold: pass tokens (up to 20) to see whether each is a preview waiting for its claim, claimed (download_vector works), expired or not found; this shows the state only, no files. With an API key, lists your conversions instead, newest first: token, file name, when

tools.name: inspect_vector
tools.description: No key needed for a token from a preview made without a key: then it shows the watermarked preview image and palette only (read-only). Other tokens need an API key. Shows a converted image as it is now, for editing with edit_vector: its palette (colours, their share and labels), its revision (rev) a

tools.name: edit_vector
tools.description: Needs an API key. Edits a converted image, free (no credits). By colour, with only the palette from inspect_vector: mergeColours {a, b} (labels; a takes b's colour), splitColour {label}, snapPalette {rules: [{color: [r,g,b], to?: [r,g,b], drop?: true, tolerance}]} (change or drop colours; tolerance

tools.name: get_account
tools.description: Needs an API key. Shows your credit balance, credit grants, plan and usage this period. Free; it costs no credits.

tools.name: create_account
tools.description: No key needed. Emails the person a link to create their free SVGMill account (or to sign in, if they have one) and returns a test-mode API key at once (free, watermarked results, no credits; it ends when the link is clicked, or after 24 hours). New accounts get 5 free credits when the person clicks

tools.name: buy_credits
tools.description: Needs an API key. Returns a Stripe Checkout link for a credit pack, for the person to open and pay; nothing is charged until they do. Packs: pack_100 (100 credits, $25), pack_1k, pack_10k, pack_25k, pack_50k, pack_100k. Credits are added after payment and last 12 months. Prices: https://svgmill.com/

tools.name: subscribe

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: create_account · Private data: convert_image_to_svg, download_vector, list_conversions, inspect_vector, edit_vector, get_account, create_account, buy_credits, subscribe · Public sink: inspect_vector, edit_vector · Destructive: download_vector, edit_vector.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: create_account · Private data: convert_image_to_svg, download_vector, list_conversions, inspect_vector, edit_vector, get_account, create_account, buy_credits, subscribe · Public sink: inspect_vector, edit_vector · Destructive: download_vector, edit_vector

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
